name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-mcp-client
title: MCP Client for SharePoint
shortDescription: A web part that acts as a Model Context Protocol client over Streamable HTTP, speaking the stateless 2026-07-28 revision, with the full JSON-RPC trace rendered in the page.
longDescription: Existing MCP work in the SharePoint space exposes SharePoint to external hosts. This sample inverts that: SharePoint is the host surface and the MCP server is consumed from the browser. It implements the 2026-07-28 protocol revision, which removed the initialize handshake and Mcp-Session-Id in favour of self contained requests, and it implements the parts of that revision clients must support: Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name header mirroring, x-mcp-header parameter mirroring, the Base64 sentinel encoding, and client side rejection of malformed tool definitions. A mock MCP server runs in the browser tab so the sample works with no server to deploy and no CORS to configure, and it validates the header requirements so a wrong client is caught rather than tolerated.

thumbnails.alt: A tools/call request in the trace panel, showing the MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name and Mcp-Param-Region headers alongside the JSON-RPC body
